execution_order.text: The sessions were aimed at enhancing the skills of the participants through an intensive course.
The training covered HPLC principles, analytical methods, and AAS principles for six participants.
Ambassador Peter Chai-en Chen emphasized the importance of these initiatives in advancing agricultural practices.
The Minister for Agriculture expressed gratitude for the continued support and highlighted the potential advantages of the training.
The focus will be on ensuring the National Agriculture Diagnostic Facilities can improve and meet food safety standards.
Minister Prosper stated that the Agriculture Ministry is prepared to support agricultural productivity and food security.
